clinical_intent: I am treating a 60-year-old male with a 4 cm anal canal squamous cell carcinoma (Stage III, T3N1M0). He has well-controlled HIV with CD4 count of 420 and undetectable viral load on antiretroviral therapy. He has a history of IV drug use (clean for 5 years) and hepatitis C (SVR achieved). He has moderate depression requiring sertraline. He has no prior radiation. Standard treatment is concurrent chemoradiation (Nigro protocol). Should I modify the standard radiation dose or fractionation given his HIV status? Should I consider brachytherapy boost? What concurrent chemotherapy would be appropriate? How should I manage his depression during treatment?
